summary_rationale: Sai Life Sciences is an integrated, 100% regulated-market innovator CRDMO combining frontline US/UK discovery and process R&D hubs (Boston, Manchester) with commercial-scale Indian manufacturing (Hyderabad, Bollaram, Bidar; ~920 KL capacity, 34 active commercial NCEs, ~160 pipeline programs). Following its FY20-FY23 SaiNxt investment trough (14% OPM in FY23), operating leverage drove FY26 revenue to Rs 2,192 Cr (+29% YoY), OPM to 29% (28% in H1 FY27), ROCE to 19.6%, and CFO/EBITDA conversion to 86% (Rs 509 Cr CFO). Large-pharma revenue share rose from 28% (FY22) to 49% (FY26) across 18 of the top 25 global pharma firms, with new modalities (peptides, OEB 6 HPAPI/ADC payloads, amidites) reinforcing switching costs. Watchpoints warranting PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health: (1) negative FCF (-Rs 83 Cr in FY26) and rising borrowings (Rs 620 Cr at Sep 2026) amid an aggressive Rs 1,100-1,300 Cr FY27 capex cycle (CWIP Rs 560 Cr); (2) Working Capital Days expanding from 12 (FY24) to 70 (FY26); and (3) Top-10 customer concentration at 54% alongside ongoing USFDA/PMDA compliance vigilance.
